title: B1022 - B1022
models: Audi A3 / VW Golf / Seat Leon
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri Open Circuit to Seat Occupied Recognition Control Module (J706)
Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları to Seat Occupied Recognition Control Module (J706)  blown or missing
Seat Occupied Recognition Control Module (J706) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri for Open Circuit to Seat Occupied Recognition Control Module (J706)
Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları to Seat Occupied Recognition Control Module (J706)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Seat Occupied Recognition Control Module (J706)
technicalNotes: When found in Golf Mk6 based vehicles with the  AirbagVW10G system installed check the Auto-Scan for 08-Auto HVAC fault codes related to (G65) High Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri such as B10AE/9481748 - High Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri: Open or Short to Ground.  If open or short to ground DTCs for the (G65) High Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri are stored in conjunction with this Airbag system DTC check to make sure the shared fuse isn't blown.
